title: SKILL FIRST · SOUTHPAW STEP AND RESET
featuredMode: Shadow or bag → medicine ball + cable → shadow or bag
emphasis: Shift from yesterday’s planned guard-recovery work to Friday’s striking rhythm. Keep the skill stage controlled: right-lead movement, clean 1–2, then a complete stance reset before flowing again.

ignition.name: Moving Southpaw Rhythm Prep
ignition.prescription: Move continuously: 2 min southpaw stance checks and easy forward/back steps, 2 min right-lead step-outs and pivots, then 1 min relaxed right jab with a full stance reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.home: Move continuously: 2 min southpaw stance checks and easy forward/back steps, 2 min right-lead step-outs and pivots, then 1 min relaxed right jab with a full stance reset. Demo unavailable.
ignition.away: Use the same unloaded footwork sequence in a clear space.
ignition.cue: Let the right lead foot organize the stance before the hands fire.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: SKILL · STEP, 1–2, RESET
deposits.effort: One uninterrupted 8-min technical block. No rep target; use natural resets and protect stance quality.

exercises.name: Southpaw Right-Lead Step → 1–2 → Stance Reset
exercises.prescription: Flow continuously in southpaw: organize the right-lead step, land a relaxed right jab–left cross, recover both hands and feet, then reset naturally. Shadowbox or use a bag. Unresisted is the default. If already familiar, the Dopa Boxing Footwork drill is optional and must not alter stance or timing. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/boxing-footwork-workout-with-dopa-resistance-band/
exercises.home: Flow continuously in southpaw: organize the right-lead step, land a relaxed right jab–left cross, recover both hands and feet, then reset naturally. Shadowbox or use a bag. Unresisted is the default. If already familiar, the Dopa Boxing Footwork drill is optional and must not alter stance or timing. Brand drill: https://dopamineo.com/boxing-footwork-workout-with-dopa-resistance-band/
exercises.away: Shadowbox the same complete step, 1–2 and stance-reset sequence continuously.
exercises.cue: Right lead foot first; finish every 1–2 back in stance.
exercises.equipment: Heavy bag or open floor; Dopa optional

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: TRANSFER · ROTATE AND RETURN TO STANCE
deposits.effort: Crisp power first, then controlled strength. Keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve; no load progression is prescribed.

exercises.name: Rotational Medicine-Ball Slam
exercises.cue: Drive from the floor and finish the rotation without overreaching.
exercises.prescription: 3 crisp rotational slams per side with a slam-safe medicine ball. Each 30-sec side window is a pacing allowance for full resets, never AMRAP. Stop if speed or posture drops.
exercises.home: 3 crisp rotational slams per side with a slam-safe medicine ball. Each 30-sec side window is a pacing allowance for full resets, never AMRAP. Stop if speed or posture drops.
exercises.away: Perform 3 fast but controlled shadow throws per side without releasing an object.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Low-to-High Cable Rotation
exercises.cue: Turn through the trunk while the base stays organized.
exercises.prescription: 6 controlled rotations per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Build trunk transfer without letting the hips collapse.
exercises.home: 6 controlled rotations per side. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Build trunk transfer without letting the hips collapse.
exercises.away: Perform 6 slow unloaded low-to-high rotations per side.

exercises.name: Split-Stance Single-Arm Cable Press
exercises.cue: Press without losing the stance or letting the ribs flare.
exercises.prescription: 6 clean presses per side from a stable split stance. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Match the stance control used to deliver and recover the rear hand.
exercises.home: 6 clean presses per side from a stable split stance. Each 30-sec side window is pacing only, never AMRAP. Match the stance control used to deliver and recover the rear hand.
exercises.away: Use a light dumbbell or perform 6 controlled shadow presses per side.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: ROUNDS · HOLD THE SOUTHPAW RHYTHM
deposits.effort: 2 min technical bag or shadow work, then 1 min full reset. Smooth rhythm, not a conditioning sprint.

exercises.name: Southpaw Step-and-Reset Round
exercises.prescription: Shadowbox or work the bag at a controlled pace. Keep returning to the same right-lead step, relaxed 1–2 and complete stance reset. Add no extra combination until the reset stays clean. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Shadowbox or work the bag at a controlled pace. Keep returning to the same right-lead step, relaxed 1–2 and complete stance reset. Add no extra combination until the reset stays clean. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Shadowbox the same right-lead step, 1–2 and reset in a clear space.
exercises.cue: The combination is not finished until your stance is rebuilt.

levels.floor: 10:00 · 2 min moving southpaw prep + 6 min uninterrupted timed step–1–2–reset flow + 2 min support: 1×3/side shadow rotational throws with setup/reset
levels.standard: 38:25 · includes setup, side switches and rest

weekSummary: Moving southpaw prep → continuous step-and-reset skill → rotational transfer strength → repeat the same skill in rounds
